tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ga'u ma'i dbang skur bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ dang po maṇḍal 'dab bzhi phyogs tshon la/ lte ba ser po de'i mthar/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod gtor gyis bskor/ slob dpon gyis bde mchog lhan skyes ser po'am sngon po'i bdag bskyed yi ge bdun pa'i bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas swa bhā was sbyangs/ ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rin po che'i khri seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa bde mchog sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan can/ yum dang gnyis su med pa mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas pa bsgom/ shar du dges pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs/ lhor gsang ba 'dus pa/ nub tu mahā mā yā/ byang du 'jigs byed bsgom/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang skur lnga ka la rigs bdag mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab/ yang na rigs bdag dang bcas pa can du bsam yang rung / mchod pa byin brlab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal la sa pā ri wa ra re re'i mgor sbyar nas/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dril gsil dang dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ oṃ sarba nas sa pā ri wa ra'i mthar nang mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las dang / thams cad dngos po'i sogs rang rang gi bstod pas bstod/ yang na lnga char la chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod/ gtor ma byin brlab la/ oṃ sarba nas/ sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa bya/ rgyud sde chen po lnga'i lha tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol//

༈ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo bla ma dang dbyer med du mos la/ maṇḍal/ dga' chen khyod bdag rgyun bshags sogs dkyus bzhin/ thod pa'i nang du rang lus bdud rtsir bsam zhing / thog ma med pa nas da lta bar gyi lus longs spyod dge rtsa rnams stong gsum gser gyis bkang ba'i rnam par bsgyur te/ yid kyis 'bul/ dbang bzhi bskur bar gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi blang rjes gtso bo sogs slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin byed/ ༈ slob mas maṇḍal gsol btab rgyun bshags/ slob ma skad cig gi pad nyi'i steng du bde mchog du bskyed la ye shes dbab/ de nas dbang bskur bya ba ni/ slob ma rang gi mdun du thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rang lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam la dbul du gzhug stong gsum 'di'ang gser gyis bkang la yon du 'bul bar bsam la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma rin chen bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par byon/ bla ma'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / rang gi smin phrag gi oṃ la thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag par bsam/ bla mas kyang de bzhin du bsam/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig ces brjod cing yi ge bdun pa dang / dril gsil/ sku'i byin rlabs lus la bcug cing dbang bskur ro/ /yang mchod pa snga ma ltar mchod la/ gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gnyis yang de dang de bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po dang / thugs kha'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sngar ltar blang ngo /

/yi ge bdun pa brjod cing dril gsil bya/ yang mchod pa phul/ dbang bzhi pa gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'od kyi rnam par byon te/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge la thim/ de las 'od 'phros dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad 'od kyis gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas/ lus lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la sems ma bcos par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /dril gsil/ ye shes rgya mtsho las/ bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ /sa lam rim pa ma lus bgrod/ /ces lan gsum brjod de phyi'i dbang ngo / /yang shar gyi dges rdor 'od du yal song / dbus kyi bde mchog la thim/ de bzhin rim gyis thim pas smin mtshams su sleb pas bum dbang / mgrin par gsang dbang / snying gar shes rab ye shes kyi lte bar slebs 'od du yal lus stong sangs song ste mi dmigs pa'i ngang la sems ma bcos par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste nang gi dbang bzhi'o/ /dril gsil/ dbang bzhi'i zin bris yin/ dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis rdzong dga' ldan du phyag len du bkod pa'o// //sarba maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 ngag dbang chos grags/ phyag rgya chen po'i ga'u ma'i dbang skur/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
